26: BOOTSTRAP_MAGIC = b"UOINKBP1"
27: MAX_BODY = 262144

40: def _require(value, message):

42:         raise ProtocolRefusal(message)

45: def _hex(value):
46:     return type(value) is str and len(value) == 64 and all(char in HEX for char in value)

49: def _outbound_bound(value):
50:     # Conservative JSON encoding budget before json.dumps. Exact built-in types
51:     # avoid user-controlled encoders, iteration methods and scalar coercions.
52:     pending = [(value, 0)]
53:     nodes, budget = 0, 0
54:     while pending:
55:         item, depth = pending.pop()
56:         nodes += 1
57:         _require(nodes <= 8192 and depth <= MAX_DEPTH, "outbound_structure_bound")
58:         if type(item) is str:
59:             _require(len(item) <= 65536, "outbound_string_bound")
60:             budget += 2
61:             for char in item:
62:                 code = ord(char)
63:                 budget += 12 if code > 65535 else 6 if code > 127 or code < 32 else 2 if char in ('"', "\\") else 1
64:                 _require(budget <= MAX_BODY, "outbound_encoding_bound")
65:         elif item is None or type(item) is bool:
66:             budget += 5
67:         elif type(item) is int:
68:             _require(-(1 << 63) <= item < 1 << 64, "outbound_integer_bound")
69:             budget += 21
70:         elif type(item) is float:
71:             _require(math.isfinite(item), "outbound_float_bound")
72:             budget += 32
73:         elif type(item) is dict:
74:             _require(len(item) <= 1024 and all(type(key) is str for key in item), "outbound_object_bound")
75:             budget += 2 + 2 * len(item)
76:             for key, child in item.items():
77:                 pending.append((key, depth + 1))
78:                 pending.append((child, depth + 1))
79:         elif type(item) is list:
80:             _require(len(item) <= 2048, "outbound_array_bound")
81:             budget += 2 + len(item)
82:             pending.extend((child, depth + 1) for child in item)
83:         else:
84:             raise ProtocolRefusal("outbound_nonpassive_type")
85:         _require(budget <= MAX_BODY and len(pending) <= 8192, "outbound_encoding_bound")

88: def _bounded_json(raw):
89:     _require(type(raw) is bytes and 0 < len(raw) <= MAX_BODY, "frame_body_bound")
90:     depth, quoted, escaped = 0, False, False
91:     for byte in raw:
92:         if quoted:
93:             if escaped:
94:                 escaped = False
95:             elif byte == 92:
96:                 escaped = True
97:             elif byte == 34:
98:                 quoted = False
99:         elif byte == 34:
100:             quoted = True
101:         elif byte in (91, 123):
102:             depth += 1
103:             _require(depth <= MAX_DEPTH, "frame_json_depth")
104:         elif byte in (93, 125):
105:             depth -= 1
106:             _require(depth >= 0, "frame_json_depth")
107:     _require(depth == 0 and not quoted, "frame_json_shape")
108:     def pairs(items):
109:         result = {}
110:         for key, value in items:
111:             _require(key not in result, "duplicate_json_key")
112:             result[key] = value
113:         return result
114:     def reject_constant(value):
115:         raise ProtocolRefusal("nonfinite_json_constant")
116:     try:
117:         value = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_constant=reject_constant)
118:     except (ValueError, UnicodeError, RecursionError) as exc:
119:         raise ProtocolRefusal("malformed_frame_json") from exc
120:     _require(type(value) is dict, "frame_json_object")
121:     # json.loads permits finite syntax whose exponent overflows to infinity.
122:     # Apply the same exact-type, numeric, node and encoded-size bounds inbound.
123:     _outbound_bound(value)
124:     return value

127: @dataclass(frozen=True)
128: class GenerationBinding:
129:     generation_hex: str
130:     manifest_sha256: str
131:     namespace_sha256: str
132:     bootstrap_source_sha256: str
133:     process_creation_time: int
134: 
135:     def encoded(self):
136:         for value in (self.generation_hex, self.manifest_sha256, self.namespace_sha256, self.bootstrap_source_sha256):
137:             _require(_hex(value), "generation_binding_digest")
138:         _require(type(self.process_creation_time) is int and 0 < self.process_creation_time < 1 << 64,
139:                  "process_creation_binding")
140:         return bytes.fromhex(self.generation_hex + self.manifest_sha256 + self.namespace_sha256
141:                              + self.bootstrap_source_sha256) + self.process_creation_time.to_bytes(8, "big")
142: 
143: 
144: def encode_private_bootstrap(binding, master_key):
145:     # This packet is only for the controller-created, inherited private pipe.
146:     # It must not be logged, placed on a command line, or accepted from a file.
147:     _require(type(binding) is GenerationBinding and type(master_key) is bytes and len(master_key) == 32,
148:              "private_bootstrap_material")
149:     binding.encoded()
150:     return BOOTSTRAP.pack(BOOTSTRAP_MAGIC, master_key, bytes.fromhex(binding.generation_hex),
151:                           bytes.fromhex(binding.manifest_sha256), bytes.fromhex(binding.namespace_sha256),
152:                           bytes.fromhex(binding.bootstrap_source_sha256), binding.process_creation_time)
153: 
154: 
155: def decode_private_bootstrap(packet):
156:     _require(type(packet) is bytes and len(packet) == BOOTSTRAP.size, "private_bootstrap_packet_bound")
157:     magic, key, generation, manifest, namespace, source, creation = BOOTSTRAP.unpack(packet)
158:     _require(magic == BOOTSTRAP_MAGIC, "private_bootstrap_magic")
159:     binding = GenerationBinding(generation.hex(), manifest.hex(), namespace.hex(), source.hex(), creation)
160:     binding.encoded()
161:     return binding, key

204: class GenerationChannel:
205:     """One direction each; private transport/bootstrap remain platform duties.
206: 
207:     master_key is an ephemeral bootstrap secret, never a provider credential or
208:     command-line argument. It must arrive only through the exact inherited
209:     private bootstrap pipe. This class does not authenticate its provenance.
210:     """
211: 
212:     def __init__(self, binding, master_key, role):
213:         _require(type(binding) is GenerationBinding and type(master_key) is bytes and len(master_key) == 32,
214:                  "private_bootstrap_material")
215:         _require(role in ("controller", "worker"), "channel_role")
216:         self.binding = binding
217:         self._context = binding.encoded()
218:         self._send_direction = 0 if role == "controller" else 1
219:         self._receive_direction = 1 - self._send_direction
220:         self._key = hmac.digest(master_key, b"uoink-generation-v1\x00" + self._context, "sha256")
221:         self._send_sequence = 0
222:         self._receive_sequence = 0
223:         self._revoked = False
224:         self._lock = RLock()
225:         self._active = False
226: 
227:     @contextmanager
228:     def _operation(self):
229:         # Keep the lock through sequence/MAC/result construction. A concurrent
230:         # revoke waits for an already-entered operation to complete; a passive
231:         # frame committed first may arrive at its caller after a later revoke.
232:         # Reentrant encode/decode refuses rather than interleaving sequences.
233:         with self._lock:
234:             self._live()
235:             _require(not self._active, "channel_operation_already_active")
236:             self._active = True
237:             try:
238:                 yield
239:             finally:
240:                 self._active = False
241: 
242:     def revoke(self):
243:         # Revocation prevents further use; Python bytes are not securely erased.
244:         with self._lock:
245:             self._revoked = True
246:             self._key = None
247: 
248:     def _live(self):
249:         _require(not self._revoked, "generation_channel_revoked")
250: 
251:     def encode(self, operation, payload):
252:         with self._operation():
253:             return self._encode(operation, payload)
254: 
255:     def _encode(self, operation, payload):
256:         self._live()
257:         valid_ops = {
258:             "challenge", "ready", "begin", "next", "segment", "done", "cancel", "closed", "error",
259:             "adopt_readset", "readset_ready", "readset_rejected",
260:             "adopt_admitted_readset", "admitted_readset_ready", "admitted_readset_rejected"
261:         }
262:         _require(type(operation) is str and operation in valid_ops, "wire_operation")
263:         _require(type(payload) is dict, "wire_payload")
264:         _require(self._send_sequence < min(MAX_SEQUENCE, MAX_FRAMES), "send_sequence_limit")
